policy.hard_mechanistic_invariant: May reject candidates because the LAMP mechanism cannot work if violated.
policy.versioned_compatibility_constraint: May reject only inside the explicitly selected compatibility profile.
policy.evidence_weighted_profile: Separates validity envelopes from preferences and never silently changes compatibility profile semantics.
policy.soft_risk_ranker: May affect ranking/evidence but is not a universal wet-lab failure oracle.
policy.set_level_specificity_evidence: Evaluates complete LAMP-compatible topology and reports model limits.
policy.research_watchlist: Not allowed to influence Gen-1 selection until independently calibrated and versioned.
policy.conditional_numeric_recipe: May change bench recipe values only when an exact reviewed authority conditions the value on the selected assay context; it must not alter sequence ranking.
policy.numeric_admission_boundary: A missing public exact-product amount remains unresolved; the runtime must not invent a numeric value to make a current product executable.

entries.claim_boundary: PCRStudio reproduces the reviewed V5 geometry convention and the public Figure 1.10 Tm/terminal-six-base ΔG numeric outputs within declared regression tolerances. Regular mechanistically critical ends use Eiken's role-specific -4 kcal/mol criterion, while LF/LB use the separate V5 loop-primer screen's published 3' stability threshold of -2 kcal/mol. PCRStudio does not claim to clone PrimerExplorer's proprietary candidate-generation/search algorithm or identity with every generic Expert-Mode 5'/3' field. PrimerExplorer's dimer-check threshold is not transplanted into Primer3 because the thermodynamic models are not assumed numerically interchangeable; set-level structure evidence is evaluated separately.
